messages.text: Sunday, September 27 · Canton, Michigan
Overcast skies, full moon, and jazz echoes
A mild, overcast Sunday offers a mix of local arts and music events, alongside a significant urban development story from Ann Arbor. The moon is full, a bright presence in the autumn sky.
Today will be overcast with a high near 75°F and a low around 49°F, with no chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:27 AM and sunset is at 7:22 PM, with the full moon 99.5% illuminated.
Sunday's nearby sounds and sights

In Ann Arbor, catch the Jazz Fest at The Ravens Club starting at 2 PM, or experience the Women in Jazz Showcase at Blue LLaMA Jazz Club at 6 PM. For an artistic reception, visit Kerrytown Concert House for Esther Kirshenbaum's 'A Symphony of Seeing' at 4 PM.
My Birthday is coming up on September 30.
Ann Arbor plans for downtown sale proceeds

Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for the expected $14.2 million to $17.4 million from the sale of the city-owned Kline’s lot. The funds will be allocated across 12 distinct projects.
Tomorrow and beyond

Tomorrow, consider the Ypsi Farmers & Gardeners Oral History Exhibit at YDL-Superior or the 'FALL GARDENING CHORES' session at YDL-Whittaker at 2 PM. On September 28, Willi Carlisle performs at The Ark in Ann Arbor at 8 PM.
Satellites navigate without GPS; telescopes prepare for launch

NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and star catalogs. The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has completed its flight-readiness review and is proceeding toward final launch preparations.
The Starship schedule is unset, with no official launch date listed.
May your day unfold with quiet discoveries.
Monday, September 28 · Canton, Michigan
Partly Cloudy Skies Greet a Full Autumn Day

Expect a partly cloudy day with temperatures reaching into the mid-70s. Ann Arbor's YDL-Superior offers a look at local history with its Ypsi Farmers & Gardeners Oral History Exhibit, while the University of Michigan advances cancer research with soundwave treatments.
Today will be partly cloudy with a high near 76°F and a low around 49°F.
Sunrise is at 7:28 AM, with sunset at 7:20 PM; the moon is full and 96.9% illuminated.
Discover Local Culture and Music

For a local experience, visit the Ypsi Farmers & Gardeners Oral History Exhibit at YDL-Superior in Ypsilanti, free all day. In the evening, catch Spiral Galaxy, Viands, and Matthew Smith at Trinosophes in Detroit at 7:30 PM.
September 30 marks both My Birthday and Patrick's Birthday.
Ann Arbor Allocates Downtown Lot Sale Funds

Ann Arbor City Council has approved a plan to spend between $14.2 million and $17.4 million from the sale of the city-owned Kline’s lot. The funds will support 12 distinct projects, including those focused on affordable housing and sustainable energy.
Tomorrow Offers Tech and Comedy
Tomorrow, consider the "AI for the Everyday" workshop at Farmington Library at 6:00 PM. For entertainment, "Colin Mochrie & Brad Sherwood" will perform comedy at Sound Board in Detroit at 7:30 PM.
NASA's Starling Satellites Navigate Without GPS

NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and a catalog of space objects. Additionally, the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has cleared its flight-readiness review, moving closer to final launch preparations.
The first orbital Starship attempt is estimated no earlier than September 18, 2026, according to Next Spaceflight.
Seek out a quiet moment of discovery and let it fill your afternoon.
